content: Plan: (1) new polaris-backend bin polaris-setup (src/bin/polaris_setup.rs) using clap+rand+hex (all workspace deps), generates .env (chmod 600) and client-metadata.json from --hostname; (2) scripts/install.sh shellcheck-clean bash with set -euo pipefail, detects docker+compose v2, fetches binary if missing, runs setup, prints final docker compose command (does not run it); (3) .github/workflows/publish-image.yml triggers on push-to-main + v* tags only, builds multi-arch via buildx, pushes to ghcr.io/dollspace-gay/polaris-backend; (4) flip deploy/docker-compose.yaml from build: to image:, keep build: as commented alt; (5) update POLARIS_IMAGE_TAG default to :latest in deploy/.env.example. NO documentation changes (dispatch 2 owns those).
